ExtraDock 4.1.9 – Multi-Screen Assignment Revolution! 🖥️🔗

✨ What's New & Improved

  • Multi-Monitor Screen Assignment: The "Attach to Screen" feature has been completely rebuilt from the ground up and renamed to "Screen Assignment"! You can now assign a dock to multiple monitors — perfect for users with both home and office workstations. No more choosing just one screen!
  • Hardware-Based Screen Recognition: ExtraDock now identifies monitors using unique hardware IDs instead of display names. This means even identical monitors are recognized correctly — no more mix-ups between twin screens!
  • Automatic Screen Registration: Every monitor you connect is automatically registered. Don't need a screen anymore? Simply use the new "Forget" option to remove it from your list. Clean and simple!
  • Redesigned Screen Assignment UI: The new dropdown menu shows all your known monitors with clear indicators — green for connected, white for disconnected, and a checkmark for screens where the dock should appear. Everything at a glance!

🐛 Bug Fixes

  • Dock Settings Mix-Up Fixed: Resolved an issue where dock settings could get swapped between docks when restoring a connection. Your docks now keep their own settings where they belong!
  • Auto-Hide Race Condition: Fixed a race condition bug that caused issues with auto-hide on full-width docks. Smooth hiding and revealing, every time!
  • Clingy Screen Bug: Fixed a bug where dragging a dock attached to one screen would cause another screen to "adopt" it — no more clingy monitors stealing your docks!

💠 Known Issues

  • Phantom Screens: macOS occasionally creates phantom screen entries (e.g., "Primary Screen (1920×1080)"). We're actively identifying and blocking these cases — this does not affect your dock functionality.

📣 We Need Your Feedback!

After months of major development, we're entering a refinement phase. Screen Assignment is the first wave of fixes, and we need your help to make everything rock-solid. If something isn't working right or feels unclear — drop us an email! We can't fix what we don't know about. 😄

🚀 What's Next?

We're focused on stability and polish. Your bug reports and feedback are more valuable than ever right now. Help us perfect ExtraDock — together we'll make it bulletproof!

Thank you to the amazing ExtraDock community for your continued support and patience. Every bug report helps us build a better dock experience!

Want even more control over your workspace? Check out DockFlow to manage dock presets and create the perfect setup for every task!

And ExtraBar to create the ultimate menu bar that fits your workflow!
